selection: sorted BIST equities with local 1h archive

definition.event: closed 4h Stabil signal; post-policy arrows and separate vertical attempts
definition.capture_cutoff: scheduled bar close <= manifest timestamp minus recorded fetch duration and one second
definition.atr: causal Wilder ATR14 in 4h bars, frozen at event close
definition.weak_reaction: full next 8 bars MFE < 0.5 ATR; not inferred for censored/invalid windows
definition.return: 8th later bar close minus signal close, in frozen ATR units
definition.race: first high >= entry+ATR or low <= entry-ATR; both on same bar is ambiguous
definition.invalid: bad OHLCV or >30 percent close gap in last 20 or outcome horizon
definition.overlap: all signals retained; independent comparison keeps first per symbol >=8 bars apart
definition.ob: nearest confirmed active bearish OB remaining zone at/above close
definition.fvg: selected native active bearish FVG remaining zone at/above close; candidate excluded
definition.volume: event volume / mean of up to previous 20 positive 4h volumes; >=5 required
definition.regime: unconfirmed vertical/horizontal candidate proxy, not visual ground truth
